content:
Alternatives to instant oatmeal?
A while ago, I started getting off-brand "quick 1 minute' oats to replace the instant packets I previously ate for breakfast. I add some brown sugar and blueberries. I like the oats good enough so I've never tried other types. I know there are many other types of oatmeal, including bulk varieties. What are the differences and do you have any recommendations?

Edit: I'm still trying to learn the difference between instant, 1-minute, quick-cooking, regular, slow-cooking and steal-cut. Some of those are probably synonymous. Obviously "flavored instant oatmeal" is probably the least nutritious.
